about_the_game:
Incredibug is a colorful 3D platformer that combines fun platforming mechanics and heroic moments with a heartwarming story about friendship, teamwork, and the clash between nature and technology. You'll control Bobo, an unassuming pill bug who rises as a hero to defend the local critter community when their home is threatened by an AI-powered Smart Home system.

Accompanied by Lumi the firefly and Ronald Roach, you explore various environments—inside the robot-infested house, the garden, and underground—solving puzzles and battling robotic enemies while rolling and bouncing through a familiar world with a new perspective. With the help of unique bug allies, each offering special abilities, you'll traverse the world like a true superhero.

Become the Incredibug

As a pill bug, you'll

  • Roll, Bounce and Crawl around in a fun, physics-based movement system

  • Climb nearly anything and explore the secrets of the smart home and garden

The Power of Friendship

Since you'll make plenty of friends on your journey, you can collect their entries in your friendship journal and they'll teach you tricks like

  • Dungbeetle-crafted explosives that blow things up and boost you to new heights

  • Swinging through the world with a Grappling-Hook made of flexible spider silk

  • Blinding the minions of the metal menace using Lumi's firefly abilities

Cooperative Fun

Grab a friend and let them play as Lumi the firefly and use her abilities to support Bobo in an accessible 1.5 player coop mode that rewards teamwork with unique mechanics:

  • Amplify Bobo's abilities and speed at any time

  • Explore the world in free-flight mode

  • Pester enemies (or your friend) and distract the cleaning robots to protect your friend

  • Combine Lumi's abilities with Bobo's and experiment with powerful interactions

Funding

The development of this game's concept was funded by "FilmFernsehFonds Bayern".

name: Incredibug
short_description: Become the Incredibug: Control a cute pill bug, unite your fellow critters and rise up against a menacing smart home system in this physics-based platformer with metroidvania elements. Play together with a friend and let them support you as Lumi the firefly in our cozy 1.5 player couch-coop
